title: Four story cards to order
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: The mission in Makkah and the Hijrah
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y2 lesson 15 (Pupil PDF worksheet: four story cards to order)
intro: Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

parts.text: Teacher: 'Every tribe held the cloth, so every tribe helped. Nobody was left out. That is fair.'
Teacher orders card 1: 'First, he put down a cloth.'

questions.q: Why did the tribes agree to his idea?
questions.a: Everyone shared the honour, so it was fair
questions.model: Teacher: 'Every tribe held the cloth, so every tribe helped. Nobody was left out. That is fair.'

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, put four story cards in order (cloth, stone on cloth, tribes lift, stone in place) and say the story to your partner.
questions.a: Cloth, stone on cloth, tribes lift together, stone set in place
questions.model: Teacher orders card 1: 'First, he put down a cloth.'

questions.q: say one way you can be trustworthy at home.
questions.a: Tell the truth, return things, keep promises
